title: Merged remote code branches and recorded orphan processes are removed only by an operator command
goal: backlog.py tidy --remote lists each code/<id> branch on origin whose commits git cherry finds on origin/main, and --remote --apply deletes those in batches, refused in an agent session (bl_authority.in_agent_session) and never run by land, close or SessionStart; tidy --class process lists each process an own record names, removable only when its recorded session's coord lease is gone and its start time matches the record; --apply ends those with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after END_WAIT_S, refused in an agent session; a process no record names is listed and never signalled

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json, time
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_COORD"))}
ENV.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
ENV.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def tool(*a, env=None, ok=(0,)):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env or ENV, timeout=300)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T)
g("clone", "-q", O, C, cwd=T)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", ".keep"), "w").close()
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
WT = os.path.join(C, ".claude", "worktrees")
def wt(name, branch=None, at="HEAD"):
    p = os.path.join(WT, name)
    g("worktree", "add", "-q", *(["-b", branch] if branch else ["--detach"]), p, at, cwd=C)
    return p
n = lambda p: os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(p))
def own(p, cls, *a, env=None):
    return tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "own", str(p), "--class", cls, *a, env=env)
def rows(*a):
    return json.loads(tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--json", *a).stdout)
def by_path(rs, cls=None):
    return {n(x["path"]): x for x in rs if "path" in x and (cls is None or x.get("class") == cls)}
def push(*a, cwd=C): g("push", "-q", "origin", *a, cwd=cwd)
push("HEAD:refs/heads/code/ST-aaaaaaaa")
x = wt("agent-x", "tmp-x"); open(os.path.join(x, "f.txt"), "w").write("x"); g("add", "f.txt", cwd=x); g("commit", "-qm", "unmerged", cwd=x)
push("HEAD:refs/heads/code/ST-bbbbbbbb", cwd=x)
g("fetch", "-q", "origin", cwd=C)
remote = lambda: g("ls-remote", "origin", "refs/heads/code/*", cwd=C)
r = tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--remote")
out = r.stdout.splitlines()
assert any("code/ST-aaaaaaaa" in l and "would delete" in l for l in out), r.stdout
assert not any("code/ST-bbbbbbbb" in l and "would delete" in l for l in out), r.stdout
agent = dict(ENV, CLAUDECODE="1")
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--remote", "--apply", env=agent, ok=(2,))
assert "code/ST-aaaaaaaa" in remote(), "an agent session deleted a remote branch"
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--remote", "--apply")
assert "code/ST-aaaaaaaa" not in remote() and "code/ST-bbbbbbbb" in remote(), remote()

operator command only, forge settings unchanged

The 846 origin code/* branches remain although every request is sent with merge_request.remove_source_branch (kg_sync.push_options; request !1247 merged with force_remove_source_branch true): code/* is a protected branch pattern on the forge, a likely cause the research story confirms.
